literal_meaning: সব হাটে যাওয়া বা ঘুরে বেড়ানো লোক
figurative_meaning_bn: সবজান্তা ধরনের লোক যে সব যায়গার খবর রাখে
figurative_meaning_en: A know-it-all person who keeps abreast of news and gossip from all places
example_sentences_in_bangla: গাঁয়ের সব হাটের হেঁটো হিসেবে সে সব খবর জানে।
ও সব হাটের হেঁটো, কোনো কথা লুকিয়ে রাখতে পারে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is known as the one who has walked all markets, knowing every bit of village news.
She's a real market-walker, always up to date with all the gossip.
history: This idiom originates from the traditional Bengali village market (haat) culture, where people from surrounding areas gather weekly, and frequent visitors become sources of local information.
note: The idiom reflects the social dynamics of rural Bengal where markets serve as hubs for news exchange.
